scope: Quarterly timing bridge for the already-selected annual operating case; forecasts and timing conventions, not guidance. Annual totals unchanged.
calendar: Calendar quarters; financial-year reporting dates may differ. Specific debt months are source-based.

revenue.CPU_client: Direct unit-index times ASP-index with selected quarterly drivers. Not physical chip counts.

profit.CPU_and_CCPG: 50% contribution on quarter revenue less one-quarter of the annual retained-cost allowance; all OtherDCAI at20%. This timing allocation is not separately disclosed product-cost accounting.
profit.tax: Annual ordinary tax allocated by positive quarterly groupEBIT; no interim tax refund credited. Financing shield allocated equally, within positive annual tax capacity.

investment.reason: Front-loaded cash investment and inventory allowance for the supply ramp. Selected to expose interim funding, not sourced construction invoicing. WC includes grant receivables; no second grant charge.

treasury: Use sourced-calendar base: principal exactmonth; ordinaryinterest,capitalizedinterest,cashincome,escrow uniform;Classiq1.9B Q22027 and0.35B Q42028 analysttiming.
concentrated_timing_stress: Use agent earlyoutflow/latereceipt calendar; shift all annual new/old creditcash toQ4 and physicalcapexweights40/30/20/10. Sameannualcash, noextra economiccharge.
boundary: Quarter-end cash sufficiency is not proof of daily liquidity or unrestricted legal access. No dividends,buybacks,newdebt,insuranceornewpartnerfunding.
